messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - Elevated 5xx + latency in AWS us-east-1 impacting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Symptoms: increased 502/504 from ALB/edge and STS token egress timeouts. Affected prefixes: api.redwood.com (us-east-1), dedicated-us-east pools. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-3956789012
sam: I see the spike in Prometheus - request_rate for hosted-api down ~6%, 5xx up ~12% in the last 3m. Pulling ELB and STS logs now.
amy: Oncall handoff in 2m. Sam, can you post the quick customer-impact numbers when you have them?
matt: Noted. If this is STS/ELB egress, prepare fallback to eu-west-1 routing and fail open for non-auth calls. We should avoid global degradation.
leo: Support seeing ~15 tickets mentioning API errors (timeouts/502). Flagging high-value customers - listing in tracker.
sam: Quick checks:
```
# curl healthcheck
curl -k -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.com/health
# result: 502 1.42s (intermittent)
```
CloudWatch shows elevated TargetResponseTime and 502 counts on ALB for target group tg-hosted-api-us-east1. STS latency metric spike for AssumeRole.
jess: Datadog APM traces show auth call to STS sometimes taking >3s and then ALB returning 502. Could be regional STS/egress problem.
ops-bot: AWS Health: reported issue - "Elevated API error rates in US-EAST-1 for STS and ELB" (investigating). Link: https://status.aws/example-issue-3956
amy: I'm taking lead. Sam -> continue logs and start tracing token failures. Matt -> coordinate routing fallback. Jess -> prepare rollback if routing changes cause regressions. Leo -> assemble customer impact summary for CS and CSM.
sam: Tracing: many requests failing at token exchange step. Example log snippet: `error=STS_EGRESS_TIMEOUT, upstream=sts.amazonaws.com, attempt=1`
matt: Plan: (1) Add route policy to prefer eu-west-1 for non-PII/low-latency tolerant requests, (2) For Dedicated pools: temporarily allow cross-region routing by enabling fallback flag, (3) Increase retry/backoff for STS calls from 1 -> 3 retries with exponential backoff.

Config to flip (safe rollout):
```
PATCH /v1/config/routing
{ "prefer_region": "eu-west-1", "allow_cross_region_fallback": true }
```
amy: Rolling change to 10% of traffic now. Monitoring tokens and 5xx.

sam: 10% rollout done. Early telemetry: 5xx in us-east-1 still high, but requests routed to eu-west-1 show <1% 5xx. Latency for routed requests ~120ms higher on average.

leo: Customer-impact (preliminary): ~8% of all Hosted API requests in us-east-1 saw 5xx in past 10m, Dedicated pools saw 10-15% increased error rate for certain tenants pinned to us-east-1. No reported data loss. Some timeouts causing degraded UX.
jess: Observability: alerting threshold triggered for error budget breach on hosted-api-us-east. Creating eval to mark which prompts were affected for quality tracking.
amy: Contacting AWS support now, submitting case with logs and CloudWatch graphs. Will paste ticket ID.
support-bot: AWS support case opened: #AWS-CASE-8675309. Support acknowledges and escalated to networking/ST S teams. ETA unknown.
matt: While we wait, increase client-side retry window and surface clear error messages for customers calling from us-east. Also enable a temporary rate limit relaxation on fallback routes.
sam: Implemented STS retry bump for service-side token exchange. Patch deployed in ~2m. Monitoring for error reduction.

jess: Confirming traces show fewer STS timeouts after retry bump for routed traffic. Native us-east requests still degraded.
amy: Handoff: I'll stay as incident lead. Sam you remain lead for telemetry/logs, Matt for routing changes, Jess for observability, Leo for customer comms. Post an incident summary in #incidents-updates when we have remediation/ETA.

leo: Preparing a short CS blurb: "We're currently observing elevated API errors in US-EAST-1 due to a third-party (AWS) regional issue. We're routing traffic to alternate regions and applying retries. Some customers may see degraded latency or transient errors; no data loss. We'll update every 30m."
matt: Next actions: if AWS ETA > 30m, expand routing rollout to 30%. Need sign-off from Amy.
amy: Approve up to 30% if no improvement in 20m. Keep rollback path ready.
sam: Current numbers (T+12m): Hosted API us-east 5xx rate from 12% -> 9%, overall request success improving for routed traffic. Dedicated pools with fallback enabled showing errors down to ~6%.

support-bot: Incident ticket created in tracker: https://incidents.example/INC-3956789012. Add notes and affected customers.
jess: Adding observability runbook entries and tagging traces with incident id.
amy: Good work. Continue monitoring. I'll coordinate updates to execs and CS in 15m. If AWS posts resolution, we will roll routing back and validate. :white_check_mark:

matt: After resolution, schedule postmortem to review routing thresholds, retry policy, and whether to enable automated cross-region failover for critical traffic.

incident-bot: Incident state: ACTIVE -> mitigated? (leader: amy). Last update posted.
